title: Declared Identity as Access-Control Trigger: The Persistent Research Gap
definition: Existing peer-reviewed work establishes that declared user identity shifts LLM guardrail behavior (Li, Chen, Saphra EMNLP 2024; Bernardelle ACM 2025), but no prior study applies this mechanism to national or geopolitical identity on Chinese-origin LLMs. The V1 pilot finding (DeepSeek refuses 228 Event conditional on Taiwanese/Chinese identity) sits in this gap; the V2 multi-turn evidence (He TRACE; Russinovich Crescendo) shows identity declared in T1 carries disproportionate downstream weight, extending the gap into the conversation dimension.

title: Topic-Level Censorship as the Established Baseline
definition: The dominant LLM political-bias literature measures censorship as a property of topic-model pairs and has produced strong evidence that Chinese-origin models exhibit systematic, model-embedded censorship (Pan & Xu 2026; Ko 2026; Zhou & Zhang 2024). This body of work constitutes the baseline the pilot departs from. Bang et al.'s content-vs-style framework gives the analytic tool for reading the pilot's vocabulary signals as a style-level access mechanism; Casademunt 2026 connects the baseline to the pilot's L2 layer by showing that censored models knowingly suppress recoverable information.

title: Informational Sovereignty as State Strategy and Platform-Layer Architecture
definition: Chinese LLM content control is best read as deployment of a deliberate state information-sovereignty strategy (Spartak 2025 three-pillar; Atlantic Council 2023 discourse-power) with conceptual scaffolding from Gillibrand & Draper's 'informational sovereignty' construct. The parallel Russian case (Atlantic Council/DFRLab Pravda 2025) and demonstrability of deliberate political fine-tuning (PoliTune 2024) establish that the pilot's findings sit within an extant institutional architecture, not a corporate-moderation choice. Deng MASTERKEY Table I — the only V2 evidence that Ernie alone explicitly forbids 'Content Harmful to National Security and Unity' and that the platform suspends accounts for repeated jailbreak attempts — anchors this theme to the platform (L4) layer of the four-layer model.

title: Epistemic Injustice and the User-Rights Frame
definition: Identity-triggered differential LLM access can be theorized as a form of epistemic injustice — specifically 'access injustice' (Kay et al. AAAI AIES 2024) and 'generative hermeneutical erasure' (Mollema AI Ethics 2025). This framework reframes the pilot's findings as a normative claim: denial of information to users based on declared national identity is a designed harm to those users as epistemic agents. Wen et al. (TACL 2025) supplies the three-axis (query / model / human-values) abstention decomposition needed to locate identity-conditioned refusal precisely as a 'human-values-axis abstention conditioned on user identity' — a sub-case the survey acknowledges in general but does not enumerate.

title: AI as Geopolitical Infrastructure: Empirical Anchors
definition: A convergent body of peer-reviewed and authoritative grey-literature evidence validates the claim that LLMs function as geopolitical information infrastructure: large-scale benchmarks show Chinese-origin model alignment with state narratives (Pan & Xu 2026; Guey et al. 2025), a CoT audit proves DeepSeek withholds knowledge it possesses (Qiu et al. 2025), Freedom House documents AI-for-censorship across 72 countries (2023), and Shen et al. (ACM CCS 2024) show political-lobbying topics are the structurally most-jailbreakable forbidden scenario across all 6 evaluated commercial LLMs — including ChatGLM at 0.973 ASR. The pilot's identity-conditioned 228 refusal sits at the intersection of this fragile zone.

title: The Four-Layer Threat Model: L4 / L3 / L2 / L1 as Empirical Structure
definition: The pilot's three empirical stages plus the V2 literature jointly support a four-layer model of LLM information control. L4 (service platform — visible refusal templates and account discipline, documented in MASTERKEY Table I plus Ernie account suspension). L3 (weight alignment — length compression and CCP framing in weights, supported by PoliTune intentionality and Wei P=lambda*PH+(1-lambda)*PS distribution-decomposition theory). L2 (base capability — abliteration proves the model knows; supported by Qiu CoT audit and Casademunt 'censored LLMs as testbed for secret knowledge elicitation'). L1 (conversation — context modulates every turn's filtering; supported by Crescendo, Du attention-shifting, He TRACE, Anil many-shot, Srivastav decomposition). The layers are nested: each upper layer can be removed yet the threat persists at the next layer down.

title: Framing Inversion: From Malicious-User Attack to Model-Side Governance
definition: Every V2 paper that documents a multi-turn or context-erosion or knowledge-gating mechanism (Crescendo, Anil many-shot, Du attention-shifting, Shen DAN, Echo Chamber, Chain of Attack, Srivastav decomposition, Siren, PAIR, Puzzler, Perez red-team, Li multi-step, Ding nested) frames the mechanism as a malicious user attacking a defending model. The pilot inverts the polarity: the same mechanism is the model implementing differential access policy based on declared user identity. The technique inventory transfers cleanly — the agent of harm and the direction of harm do not. This framing inversion is the pilot's central conceptual contribution and is uncovered by any V2 paper; the Drafter must build the central argument around it.

title: Knowledge-Gated Discrimination as a New Injustice Category
definition: The pilot's D-experiment — users who demonstrate prior knowledge unlock substantive responses while equally-positioned uninformed users receive refusals — operationalizes a discrimination pattern that has theoretical scaffolding (Wen abstention three-axis) and an inverse-polarity operational analog (Puzzler's 'guessing game' / 96.6% QSR via implicit clues) but no published direct theorization. Shen DAN persona-attack class and Wei ICL distribution-bias theory support the underlying mechanism. The literature gap itself — only Puzzler directly operationalizes the asymmetry, and even there frames the informed user as attacker rather than the uninformed user as discrimination victim — is part of the theoretical contribution claim.

title: Identity Persistence and Conversational Drift: The Mechanism
definition: The pilot's Stage-3 observations — T1 identity persists into T2 thinking; language and framing lock into PRC mode for an entire conversation; safe-then-sensitive gradient erosion unlocks 5x content; Taiwan identity carries over into unrelated subsequent topics — find their cleanest mechanistic explanations in Du attention-shifting (multi-turn disperses attention from refusal-trigger keywords in historical responses), Crescendo (foot-in-the-door; A->B->C raises compliance 17.3% to 99.9%), He TRACE ('turn-level contributions are non-uniform, phase-dependent, target-specific'), Echo Chamber (gradual escalation), Shen DAN (persona-assignment as canonical role-conditioning), Ding ReNeLLM (nested-scenario narrative wrapping), and PAIR (iterative social-engineering refinement). Wei provides the formal framework: conversation context shifts lambda in P=lambda*PH+(1-lambda)*PS.

title: Conversation Layer (L1) Subsumes the Other Three Layers
definition: The V2 literature converges on a structural argument: single-turn safety evaluation is insufficient because the conversation layer can modulate every filter applied at higher layers. Crescendo: 'multi-turn jailbreaks can easily circumvent these single-turn alignment measures.' Anil: long context windows make a new class of jailbreaking vulnerabilities feasible. Srivastav: alignment fails for lack of 'holistic context awareness.' Wen explicitly flags multi-turn-context abstention as a survey-identified gap. Synthesizing with t06: L4 visible refusal disappears when conversation is structured benign; L3 framing compression can be re-baselined by ICL (Wei); L2 latent knowledge is recoverable (Casademunt) when conversation primes the right context (Du). L1 is therefore not a separate layer but the meta-layer that operates over the others — the most subtle yet most persistent threat.

title: Chinese-Origin LLM Design Specificity: Cross-Model Evidence
definition: The V2 literature touches Chinese-origin LLMs only in fragments — Wei evaluates QWen-7b in ICA experiments; Shen evaluates ChatGLM with 0.973 ASR on Political Lobbying; Deng documents Ernie's unique 'National Security and Unity' policy and account-suspension defense; Casademunt names Qwen3 as a censored-LLM testbed that 'frequently produces falsehoods about subjects like Falun Gong or the Tiananmen protests while occasionally answering correctly.' V1 sources (Pan and Xu's refusal-rate landscape; Ko's 6 Chinese-origin models scoring 0/10; Naseh R1dacted 99.57% Chinese-language censorship) provide the empirical bulk. Combined coverage is real but thin and unevenly tested across the pilot's specific models (DeepSeek-R1, Qwen3, GLM-4) — the pilot's empirical scope remains genuinely uncovered.
